title: Fingerprint machine learning predicts mobility and polarity of polymer semiconductors
summary: The OFETnow platform pairs a database of polymer OFET data with a fingerprint-based machine-learning model that needs no quantum-chemical descriptors. After an external check on recently reported polymers excluded from the database, five designed polymers were made; measured device mobilities and carrier types agreed closely with predictions, and a deliberately low-mobility control was discriminated.
ai_technology: Fingerprint-based machine-learning model trained on the OFETnow polymer database

evidence.tested: Five designed polymers synthesised and measured in devices, plus external validation on excluded literature polymers.
evidence.unknown: Only five designed polymers; numerical agreement not read; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: The model predicted mobility level and carrier type and interpretability analysis guided selection of building blocks.
